label: Delete workout sessions with a missing plan or plan session

execute.description: delete workout sessions whose plan or plan session was removed
execute.sql: DELETE FROM "public"."workout_session" WHERE "planId" IS NULL OR "planSessionId" IS NULL

postcheck.description: verify no orphan workout sessions remain
